questions.question: A scientific study of rocks that deals with their composition, texture and structure; their occurrence and distribution; and their origin in relation to physicochemical conditions is called ________.
questions.solution:
__
 
• A scientific study of rocks that deals with their composition, texture and structure; their occurrence and distribution; and their origin in relation to physicochemical conditions is called **petrology**__.
 
• Lithology is the study of the general physical characteristics of rocks.
 
• Geology is the study of earth, its structure, materials with which it is made and other processes related to it.
 
• Geomorphology is the study of physical features of the earth's surface and their relation to the geological structure of the earth.

questions.question: In India, which of the following article of the Constitution of India provides for the formation of a new state?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Article 3**__ of the Constitution of India provides for the formation of a new state.
 
• Article 1 states that India shall be a union of states.
 
• Article 9 deals with the law of Indian nationality.
 
• Article 2 states that the Parliament may add or establish new states into the union of India.

questions.question: Sir Thomas Roe visited the court of Mughal ruler _______ as the ambassador of the king of England.
questions.solution:
__
 
• Sir Thomas Roe visited the court of Mughal ruler **Jahangir**__ as the ambassador of the king of England, in 1615.
 
• He lived as a resident of Agra till 1619.
 
• He was an English diplomat of the Jacobean and the Elizabethan period.
 
• He compiled a work titled Journal of the Mission to the Mogul Empire.

questions.question: Rule ________ (of the Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in Lok Sabha) does NOT involve a formal motion before the Parliament House, hence no voting can take place after discussion on matters under this rule.
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Rule 193**__ (of the Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in Lok Sabha) does not involve a formal motion before the Parliament House, hence no voting can take place after the discussion on matters under this rule.
 
• Rule 184 allows voting but rule 193 doesn't.
 
• Lok Sabha is the lower house of the Parliament, while Rajya Sabha is the upper house.

questions.question: A _______ is not constrained by prior work.
questions.solution:
__
 
• A **greenfield project**__ is not constrained by prior work.
 
• These are constructed on unused lands where there is not any need to demolish or remodel an existing structure.
 
• Some of its examples are airports, power plants, or factories built from scratch.
 
• A strategic alliance is an agreement between 2 parties, wherein, they undertake a mutually beneficial project and both retain their independence.

questions.question: A marketplace in which a final good or service is bought and sold is called ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option 4 i.e. __**Product Market.**__

__
 
• A marketplace in which a final good or service is bought and sold is called **Product Market**__.
 
• **A factor market** is where the companies purchase what they need to produce their services and goods.
 
• **A commodity market **is a virtual or physical marketplace for selling, buying, and trading primary or raw products.
 
• **The equity market** is for trading equity instruments. It is also known as the stock market.

questions.question: In March 2019, the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) of India grounded which aircraft due to technical fault?
questions.solution:
__
 
• In March 2019, the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) of India grounded **Boeing 737 Max 8 **__due to technical fault.
 
• SpiceJet had 12 such aircraft in its fleet, while Jet Airways had five.
 
• Boeing 737 Max 8 is manufactured by Boeing Commercial Airplanes and performed its first flight in 2016.
 
• After 2 deadly plane crashes which killed nearly 346 people in 5 months, it was finally grounded by most of the countries.

questions.question: Which one of the following is the deepest gorge in the world?
questions.solution:
__

• Its upper part is known as Thak Khola.
 
• Garganta del Cares is situated in Spain.

• Tiger Leaping Gorge is situated in China.

questions.question: Which human body part can well be called the 'chemical factory' of our body?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Liver**__ is called the 'chemical factory' of our body.
 
• The liver is the prime source which is responsible for breaking down food into new components which are used to keep the body healthy.
 
• Some of the major functions of the liver include bile production, fat metabolization, mineral and vitamin storage, filtering the blood etc.
 
• The stomach helps in the digestion of food.
 
• Lungs help in the process of respiration.
 
• Kidneys help in removing body waste in the form of urine.

questions.question: Opium wars were fought between the British and ________.
questions.solution:
__
 
• Opium wars were fought between the British and **China**__.
 
• The war took place in the mid-19th century.
 
• The first one was held between China and British in 1839-42.
 
• The second one was fought between France and Britain against China in 1856-60.

questions.question: _______ gases trap heat in the atmosphere which makes the Earth warmer, causing global warming.
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Greenhouse**__ gases trap heat in the atmosphere which makes the Earth warmer, causing global warming.
 
• Greenhouse effect is a process that occurs when the temperature of the Earth traps the sun's heat and this, in result, makes the earth much warmer.
 
• Global warming occurs when greenhouse gases, carbon dioxide and other pollutants collect in the atmosphere and absorb solar radiations and sunlight.
 
• The average global temperature in the past 50 years has increased tremendously because of it.

questions.question: British East India Company defeated the Portuguese in the ___________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Battle of Suvali​**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In 1612 the East India Company's ships defeated the Portuguese in the Swally estuary off Surat.
 
• The naval Battle of Swally, also known as Battle of Suvali, took place on 29–30 November 1612 off the coast of Suvali a village near the Surat city and was a victory for four English East India Company galleons over four Portuguese galleons.
 
• This relatively small naval battle is historically important as it marked the beginning of the ascent of the English East India Company's presence in India.
 
• This battle also convinced the English East India Company to establish a small navy to safeguard their commercial interests from other European powers and also from pirates. 
 
• The background to this battle also points to the main reason for the Dutch Vereenigde Oostindische Compagnie being organized in 1602.

questions.question: Who among the following was the first Chinese to receive the Nobel Prize for literature?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Mo Yan**__ was the first Chinese to receive the Nobel Prize for literature in the year 2012.
 
• His first work was published in the year 1981.
 
• He is also the 109th recipient of the award.
 
• Some of his acclaimed works include Big Breasts and Wide Hips and Republic of Wine.

questions.question: Bihar Diwas is annually celebrated on ________ to commemorate the day Bihar was carved out from the Bengal Presidency.
questions.solution:
__
 
• Bihar Diwas is annually celebrated on **22 March**__ to commemorate the day Bihar was carved out from the Bengal Presidency.
 
• It was on this day in 1912 that the state was finally carved out.
 
• March 22, 2019 was the 107th foundation day of Bihar.
 
• The day was first celebrated on a long-scale in 2010.

questions.question: Tipu Sultan and British East India Company signed the Treaty of Mangalore in the year _______.
questions.solution:

• Tipu Sultan was the ruler of the Mysore Kingdom.
 
• The Second Anglo-Mysore War took place from 1780-84 between the British East India Company and the Mysore Kingdom.

questions.question: Nitrous Oxide is the chemical name of ________.
questions.solution:
__
 
• Nitrous Oxide' is the chemical name of **Laughing Gas**__.

questions.question: Which country won the South Asian Football Federation (SAFF) women's Championship in 2019?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **India**__ won the South Asian Football Federation (SAFF) women's Championship in 2019 for the 5th time in a row.
 
• The final was held at Biratnagar and Nepal was defeated by 3-1.
 
• Since the inception 2010, this was India's 23rd victory in the championship.
 
• Indian has won every edition of this tournament till now and beat Nepal 4 times and Bangladesh once.

questions.question: How many provinces are there in Sri Lanka?
questions.solution:
__
 
• There are a total of **9**__ provinces and 25 states in Sri Lanka.
 
• These were created in 1987 by the 13th Amendment of the Sri Lankan Constitution.
 
• These 9 provinces are Central, Eastern, North Central, Northern, North Western, Sabaragamuwa, Southern, Uva, and Western.

questions.question: Both, haemoglobin and myoglobin require _______ for formation.
questions.solution:
__
 
• Both, haemoglobin and myoglobin require **iron**__ for formation.
 
• Haemoglobin carries oxygen pigments and is made of protein and prosthetic group.
 
• It transports oxygen throughout the body and gives color to the blood.
 
• Myoglobin receives oxygen from the RBCs and works for muscle cells only.
 
• It helps in regulating the body temperature.

questions.question: Which of the following is the longest river in Pakistan that originates from Lake Manasarovar?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Indus**__ is the longest river in Pakistan that originates from Lake Manasarovar.
 
• In terms of annual water flow, it is the 21st largest river of the world.
 
• It is also known as Pakistan's lifeline and is 3,180 km long.
 
• Sutlej river flows through northern India and Pakistan and is a tributary of the river Indus.
 
• Kabul river originates in Afghanistan.
 
• Chenab is one of the 5 major rivers of Punjab and flows through India and Pakistan.

questions.question: In China, 2019 (which starts on 5 February and ends on 24 January) is the year of the ________.
questions.solution:
__
 
• In China, 2019 (which starts on 5 February and ends on 24 January) is the year of the **Pig**__.
 
• Pig, in Chinese zodiac, is the 12-year cycle of animals.
 
• The years of the Pig are 2019, 2007, 1995, 1983, 1971, 1959, 1947, 1935, 1923, 2031, 2043....
 
• The 12 Chinese zodiac animals are rat, tiger, ox, dragon, rabbit, snake, horse, monkey, goat, dog, pig, and rooster.
